audit.scope: read-only static code-health and release audit; no source, tests, package, proof, or git state modified

tests.steps: Read git status, HEAD, and run git diff --check.
tests.expected: Audit records inherited changes and no whitespace errors.
tests.actual: Worktree has extensive pre-existing tracked and untracked changes; HEAD is 94f9073a134af7c2c5a7a2a2ecb8eca50362d7c6; git diff --check exited 0.
tests.notes: No attempt was made to clean, stage, commit, or revert inherited work.

tests.steps: Run NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 npx tsc --noEmit.
tests.expected: Zero compiler errors.
tests.actual: Command exited 0 with no compiler output.

tests.steps: Run npm run lint.
tests.expected: Zero errors and warnings.
tests.actual: expo lint exited 0 with no reported findings.

tests.steps: Run npm test once.
tests.expected: All configured tests pass.
tests.actual: npm test exited 0; configured guard, architecture, storage, reader, language, security, and spacing suites completed.

tests.steps: Run the full npm test command three consecutive times.
tests.expected: All three runs pass consistently.
tests.actual: Runs 1, 2, and 3 completed; wrapper exited 0.

tests.steps: Run npm audit --audit-level=high.
tests.expected: Zero critical/high vulnerabilities, or a documented accepted exception.
tests.actual: 27 vulnerabilities reported: 18 high and 9 moderate. High findings include braces and node-forge; npm recommends a breaking npm audit fix --force path.
tests.notes: No dependency changes made because FIX_MODE=false.

tests.steps: Run npx expo-doctor and npx expo install --check.
tests.expected: Config schema valid, peer dependencies complete, and SDK versions aligned.
tests.actual: expo-doctor failed 3 checks: app.json splash schema property rejected, expo-asset peer dependency missing for expo-audio, and seven Expo packages are patch-outdated. expo install --check independently reported the same seven outdated packages.

tests.steps: Run scripts/check-colors.js and independently scan source guardrail patterns.
tests.expected: No unauthorized color literals, raw Text, or legacy imports.
tests.actual: check-colors failed one violation: src/components/AnimatedSplash.tsx:32 hardcoded #E6BE6C. Independent scan found 5 direct react-native Text imports, 18 raw Text tags, 450 raw color matches, and 3 expo-file-system/legacy imports. src/_legacy does not exist.
tests.notes: The broad raw-color count includes legitimate assets/content/style cases; the dedicated guard failure is the actionable result.

tests.steps: Attempt node scripts/check-logos.js because the requested script was named in scope.
tests.expected: Existing script runs and reports logo consistency.
tests.actual: scripts/check-logos.js is absent; Node returned MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
tests.notes: No script was created because this is an audit-only task.

tests.steps: Run node scripts/check-spacing.js.
tests.expected: Guard passes.
tests.actual: Guard exited 0.

tests.steps: Parse all locale JSON files and compare key sets and empty values to en.json.
tests.expected: Every locale has 2302 identical keys and no empty values.
tests.actual: 49 locale files parsed. kk.json has 2263 keys and is missing 39 keys; other checked locale files matched the base key count with no empty values.

tests.steps: Scan source/config/test JavaScript and TypeScript files excluding generated/dependency/evidence directories.
tests.expected: No TODO/FIXME, debug console.log, or secret-like literals.
tests.actual: Scan covered 599 files and found matches. Results include many console.log calls in tests/scripts and legitimate prose containing the words secret; no private-key block was established by this broad scan.
tests.notes: Broad pattern results require cleanup/classification; prose false positives are retained rather than silently discarded.

tests.steps: Review the scan_terms output for credential-shaped patterns and API-key markers.
tests.expected: No credential-shaped secrets committed.
tests.actual: No credential-shaped private-key block or API-key assignment was identified in the retained scan output; generic 'secret' prose was present.
tests.notes: This is a static heuristic, not proof that runtime or external services have no secrets.

tests.steps: Compare screen filenames with App.tsx references.
tests.expected: No unreachable shipped screen files, or each candidate is explicitly classified.
tests.actual: 50 screen files scanned; BackupRestoreScreen.tsx, LegalScreen.tsx, and NotificationsScreen.tsx are not referenced by App.tsx and are dead/unreachable candidates. Automated depcheck was unavailable.
tests.notes: Not-imported does not prove globally unused because another entry point could exist; candidates require owner confirmation.

tests.steps: Attempt local madge circular-import check without installing packages.
tests.expected: Graph check runs and reports no cycles.
tests.actual: Blocked: madge is not installed and npx --no-install refused to fetch it.

tests.steps: Run npm ls --depth=0 and attempt local depcheck.
tests.expected: All declared dependencies resolve and unused/duplicate dependencies are identified.
tests.actual: npm ls exited 0 and resolved direct packages. depcheck was not installed; npx --no-install refused to fetch it, so unused/duplicate analysis is incomplete.

tests.steps: Inspect the Open Source Licenses screen and compare named direct package dependencies with package.json.
tests.expected: Direct shipped dependencies have corresponding license disclosure entries.
tests.actual: LegalScreen provides a curated list of runtime modules and fonts, but the static comparison found many direct dependencies not named there, including expo-font, expo-linear-gradient, expo-system-ui, expo-updates, expo-video, react-i18next, react-native-web, react-native-webview, and multiple font packages represented only by family names.

evidence_values.comparison_method: package names versus rendered license entry names

tests.notes: This is a coverage comparison, not an independent legal opinion on SPDX correctness.

tests.steps: Inspect existing dist artifact sizes and metadata without rebuilding.
tests.expected: Usable artifact-size evidence is available per route where possible.
tests.actual: Existing export contains one main web bundle of 6,285,990 bytes, worker 132,625 bytes, index 1,235 bytes, and dist total 26M. No route-specific bundles were present; per-route size attribution is unavailable.
tests.notes: No Expo export was run because audit scope permits writes only to S1 evidence/report files.

tests.steps: Use Phase 0 runtime inventory as the available browser evidence.
tests.expected: All 52 expected routes load with route-specific content and no blocking state.
tests.actual: Phase 0 captured only home; prayer API was unavailable and the first-launch location modal blocked library, Quran, and tools crawl. 51 routes remain unverified.
tests.notes: No fabricated route PASS rows were added.

tests.steps: Check available audit context for a device or emulator run.
tests.expected: Native splash, permissions, audio, notifications, RTL, and release behavior verified on device.
tests.actual: No physical device or emulator was used; static and web checks cannot establish native behavior.

tests.steps: Attempt the configured pygount summary with generated/dependency folders excluded.
tests.expected: Language and LOC summary generated.
tests.actual: Blocked: pygount command is not installed.

tests.steps: Reconcile failed, blocked, and passing rows from this audit.
tests.expected: Release gate passes only when required static, dependency, runtime, and device checks are clear.
tests.actual: Release gate is not clear: high vulnerabilities, Expo compatibility/config issues, locale parity failure, guardrail failure, dead candidates, incomplete license coverage, and blocked runtime/device evidence remain.
tests.notes: Audit report only; no source or dependency fixes were made.

limitations: The repository was already dirty with extensive inherited changes; no cleanup or ownership changes were made.
Runtime route crawl and native-device verification remain blocked as documented by Phase 0.
No network installs, source fixes, package updates, builds, commits, or pushes were performed.
